data.name: Sophi
data.gender_notes: Sophi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek Sophia, meaning 'wisdom' or 'intelligence'. In Christian tradition, Sophia is a symbol of divine wisdom and the feminine aspect of God. The name Sophi carries the meaning “Wisdom, Intelligence” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sophi usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge, understanding, and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Sophi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom, Intelligence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sophi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: סופי
in_hebrew.meaning: חכמה אלוהית, תבונה אלוהית, שכל גבוה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סופי נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'סופία' (סופיה), שפירושה חכמה. בקונטקסט הנוצרי, סופי מייצגת את החכמה האלוהית, התבונה שמעבר להשגת האדם. השם מופיע בברית החדשה, בספר קורינתיים ובספר יעקב, ומייצג את המתנה האלוהית של חכמה. השם סופי הוא גם קיצור של השם היווני 'סופיה', ששימש ככינוי לאלוהות הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Σοφία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σοφία προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για τη σοφία. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, η Σοφία αντιπροσωπεύει τη θεία σοφία, τη πνευματική σύνεσι που προέρχεται από τον Θεό. Η λέξη Σοφία εμφανίζεται στη Καινή Διαθήκη, στο βιβλίο της Σοφίας και στο βιβλίο του Ιακώβου, και συμβολίζει το θεϊκό δώρο της σοφίας. Το όνομα Σοφία ήταν επίσης προσωνύμιο για την χριστιανική θεότητα.

in_latin.name: Sophia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Sophia derivatur ex Graeca voce sapientiae. In contextu christiano, Sophia repraesentat sapientiam divinam, prudentiam spiritualem quae ex Deo procedit. Verbum Sophia in Novum Testamentum apparet, in libro Sapientiae et in libro Jacobi, et donum divinum sapientiae significat. Nomen Sophia etiam epitheton fuit divinitatis christianae.

in_english.name: Sophi
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sophi is derived from the Greek word for wisdom, 'sophia'. In Christian tradition, Sophi represents divine wisdom, spiritual insight, and higher understanding. The name appears in the New Testament, in the book of Wisdom and the book of James, and symbolizes the gift of wisdom from God. Historically, the name Sophi has been associated with the virtues of intelligence, discernment, and spiritual maturity. Today, the name Sophi remains a popular choice for parents seeking a name that embodies spiritual significance and intellectual curiosity.

Sophia represents the wisdom that can only come from God, an understanding of the divine that goes beyond human knowledge. It can serve as a reminder to look inward, in search of that inner wisdom and understanding. Inward contemplation and seeking knowledge from the sacred feminine symbolized by Sophia is considered a path to spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Sophia can evoke a sense of reverence and awe for the infinite wisdom and love of God.
